results.title: Data centers want to be sustainable, panelists say. Transparency also in demand
results.description: By Nicole Lopez, Fort Worth Report August 21, 2026 University of Texas at Arlington computer science and engineering assistant professor Mohammad Atiqul Islam has observed misinformation spread about data centers, particularly about how the supercomputer hubs work and their technology. That’s why he wants to see more transparency from those representing the data center industry,...
